full_text:
Article 9 (Notification of Designated Institutions)
① The Director of the Office for National Affairs shall, in accordance with Article 8, paragraph 5, publish the following information in the official gazette and make it publicly available through its website, if a research institution has been designated:
1. The name and address of the designated research institution
2. The date and period of designation
3. The main functions and roles
② The Director of the Office for National Affairs shall notify the designated research institution of the designation within 7 days from the date the research institution is designated. <Amendments: 2008.7.2, 2013.3.23>
